title: Condensin extrudes DNA loops in steps up to hundreds of base pairs that are generated by ATP binding events.
authors: Ryu, Je-Kyung; Rah, Sang-Hyun; Janissen, Richard; Kerssemakers, Jacob W J; Bonato, Andrea; Michieletto, Davide; Dekker, Cees
one_liner_zh: 该文通过磁镊和分子动力学模拟研究凝缩蛋白SMC复合物挤出DNA环的步进机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白质-DNA互作动态机制与物理模拟方法，对TF-DNA结合机理建模有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: The condensin SMC protein complex organizes chromosomal structure by extruding loops of DNA. Its ATP-dependent motor mechanism remains unclear but likely involves steps associated with large conformational changes within the  approximately 50 nm protein complex. Here, using high-resolution magnetic tweezers, we resolve single steps in the loop extrusion process by individual yeast condensins. The measured median step sizes range between 20-40 nm at forces of 1.0-0.2 pN, respectively, comparable with the holocomplex size. These large steps show that, strikingly, condensin typically reels in DNA in very sizeable amounts with  approximately 200 bp on average per single extrusion step at low force, and occasionally even much larger, exceeding 500 bp per step. Using Molecular Dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that this is due to the structural flexibility of the DNA polymer at these low forces. Using ATP-binding-impaired and ATP-hydrolysis-deficient mutants, we find that ATP binding is the primary step-generating stage underlying DNA loop extrusion. We discuss our findings in terms of a scrunching model where a stepwise DNA loop extrusion is generated by an ATP-binding-induced engagement of the hinge and the globular domain of the SMC complex.
abstract_zh: 凝缩蛋白SMC蛋白复合体通过挤出DNA环来组织染色体结构。其依赖ATP的机制尚不清楚，但可能涉及与约50纳米蛋白复合体内大型构象变化相关的步骤。在此，我们利用高分辨率磁镊，解析了单个酵母凝缩蛋白在环挤出过程中的单步事件。测得的步长中位数在1.0-0.2 pN力下分别为20-40纳米，与全复合体尺寸相当。这些大步长表明，凝缩蛋白通常以相当大的量卷取DNA，在低力下每次挤出步骤平均约200碱基对，偶尔甚至更大，单步超过500碱基对。通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们证明这是由于DNA聚合物在这些低力下的结构柔性所致。利用ATP结合受损和ATP水解缺陷突变体，我们发现ATP结合是驱动DNA环挤出的主要步进生成阶段。我们基于一种压缩模型讨论我们的发现，其中逐步的DNA环挤出由ATP结合诱导的SMC复合体铰链和球状结构域的接合所产生。
